recognize_zh: 中倍小腸黏膜絨毛變短、扭曲，固有層被密集的淋巴樣細胞浸潤而擴張，並延伸至表面上皮，隱窩結構紊亂；這種以黏膜為主的密集淋巴浸潤合併絨毛變形，是 EATL 切片的常見低倍線索。
features: Lamina propria markedly expanded by a dense lymphoid infiltrate
Infiltrate extends into and disrupts surface and crypt epithelium
Crypt architecture irregular with congested vessels
Detached fragmented mucosa at the edge of the section; cytologic detail requires higher power
describe_en: Medium-power section of small-intestinal mucosa shows blunted and distorted villi with marked expansion of the lamina propria by a dense lymphoid infiltrate that extends into the surface and crypt epithelium. Crypt architecture is irregular and vessels are congested; fragmented detached mucosa is present at the left of the field. Cytologic atypia cannot be fully assessed at this magnification. In conjunction with high-power morphology and a T-cell phenotype, findings are consistent with enteropathy-associated T-cell lymphoma involving small-bowel mucosa.

ddx.vs: Celiac disease shows villous flattening with crypt hyperplasia and a polymorphous lymphoplasmacytic infiltrate without sheets of atypical T cells.
MEITL is composed of monotonous medium cells that are CD8+ CD56+, requiring IHC to separate from EATL.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma of the small bowel
ddx.vs: DLBCL consists of large CD20+ cells and generally lacks marked epitheliotropism.
